influences.name: Jamiroquai
influences.context: An acid jazz phase, where I was listening to nothing but Jamiroquai.

influences.name: LCD Soundsystem
influences.context: We were just off the back of seeing LCD Soundsystem in LA, which was a very inspiring show, and we were instantly just like… looking up all the equipment they use and that kinda shit, trying to dial in some of those sounds and stuff.
